14	ORDER OF THE COMMISSION 
15	Ind. Code ch.  8 -1-26 provides the procedure for the Indiana Utility Regulatory 
16	Commission’s Pipeline Safety Division (“Division”) to find violations of said chapter. Upon 
17	review of those findings, the Indiana Underground Plant Protection Advisory Committee 
18	(“Advisory Committee”) reviews those recommendations and recommends civil penalties in the 
19	Case.   
20	The
21	 Cases received pursuant to Ind.  Code ch. 8-1-26 and ripe for Commission action are 
22	attached hereto and collectively referred to as the Advisory Committee Recommendations.  
23	P
24	ursuant to statute, the Advisory Committee has submitted their recommendations to the 
25	Commission. The Commission UPHOLDS the findings of violations by the Pipeline Safety 
26	Division and APPROVES the recommendations of the Advisory Committee as listed on the 
27	attached pages. The Assistant General Counsel to the Division is directed to prepare and send 
28	notice to the parties advising them of the determination. 
29	Any approved civil penalties are due within 90 days of the date of this Order unless 
30	payment arrangements are made with the Secretary of the Commission.   
31	An
32	y approved trainings must be completed no later than 180 days from  the date of this 
33	Order or the alternative civil penalty noted in the attached recommendation is due.   
34	IT
35	 IS SO ORDERED. 
36	HUSTON, FREEMAN, KREVDA, OBER, AND ZIEGNER CONCUR 
37	APPROVED: 
38	I hereby certify that the above is a true 
39	and correct copy of the Order as approved. 
40	Dana Kosco

PROVED: 
ORDER OF THE COMMISSION 
Ind. Code ch.  8 -1-26 provides the procedure for the Indiana Utility Regulatory 
Commission’s Pipeline Safety Division (“Division”) to find violations of said chapter. Upon 
review of those findings, the Indiana Underground Plant Protection Advisory Committee 
(“Advisory Committee”) reviews those recommendations and recommends civil penalties in the 
Case.   
The
 Cases received pursuant to Ind.  Code ch. 8-1-26 and ripe for Commission action are 
attached hereto and collectively referred to as the Advisory Committee Recommendations.  
P
ursuant to statute, the Advisory Committee has submitted their recommendations to the 
Commission. The Commission UPHOLDS the findings of violations by the Pipeline Safety 
Division and APPROVES the recommendations of the Advisory Committee as listed on the 
attached pages. The Assistant General Counsel to the Division is directed to prepare and send 
notice to the parties advising them of the determination. 
Any approved civil penalties are due within 90 days of the date of this Order unless 
payment arrangements are made with the Secretary of the Commission.   
An
y approved trainings must be completed no later than 180 days from  the date of this 
Order or the alternative civil penalty noted in the attached recommendation is due.   
IT
 IS SO ORDERED. 
HUSTON, FREEMAN, KREVDA, OBER, AND ZIEGNER CONCUR 
APPROVED: 
I hereby certify that the above is a true 
and correct copy of the Order as approved. 
Dana Kosco
Secretary of the Commission

18	(“Advisory Committee”) reviews those recommendations and recommends civil penalties in the

)

) 
) 
AP
PROVED: 
ORDER OF THE COMMISSION 
Ind. Code ch.  8 -1-26 provides the procedure for the Indiana Utility Regulatory 
Commission’s Pipeline Safety Division (“Division”) to find violations of said chapter. Upon 
review of those findings, the Indiana Underground Plant Protection Advisory Committee 
(“Advisory Committee”) reviews those recommendations and recommends civil penalties in the 
Case.   
The
 Cases received pursuant to Ind.  Code ch. 8-1-26 and ripe for Commission action are 
attached hereto and collectively referred to as the Advisory Committee Recommendations.  
P
ursuant to statute, the Advisory Committee has submitted their recommendations to the 
Commission. The Commission UPHOLDS the findings of violations by the Pipeline Safety 
Division and APPROVES the recommendations of the Advisory Committee as listed on the 
attached pages. The Assistant General Counsel to the Division is directed to prepare and send 
notice to the parties advising them of the determination. 
Any approved civil penalties are due within 90 days of the date of this Order unless 
payment arrangements are made with the Secretary of the Commission.   
An
y approved trainings must be completed no later than 180 days from  the date of this 
Order or the alternative civil penalty noted in the attached recommendation is due.   
IT
 IS SO ORDERED. 
HUSTON, FREEMAN, KREVDA, OBER, AND ZIEGNER CONCUR 
APPROVED: 
I hereby certify that the above is a true 
and correct copy of the Order as approved. 
 Dana Kosco
Secretary of the Commission

14	ORDER OF THE COMMISSION 
15	Ind. Code ch. 8-1-26 provides the procedure for the Indiana  Utility Regulatory 
16	Commission’s Pipeline Safety Division (“Division”) to find violations  of said  chapter. Upon 
17	review of those findings,  the Indiana Underground Plant Protection Advisory Committee 
18	(“Advisory Committee”) reviews those recommendations and recommends civil penalties in the 
19	Case.   
20	The Cases received pursuant to Ind. Code ch. 8-1-26 and ripe for Commission action are

PROVED: 
ORDER OF THE COMMISSION 
Ind. Code ch. 8-1-26 provides the procedure for the Indiana  Utility Regulatory 
Commission’s Pipeline Safety Division (“Division”) to find violations  of said  chapter. Upon 
review of those findings,  the Indiana Underground Plant Protection Advisory Committee 
(“Advisory Committee”) reviews those recommendations and recommends civil penalties in the 
Case.   
The Cases received pursuant to Ind. Code ch. 8-1-26 and ripe for Commission action are 
attached hereto and collectively referred to as the Advisory Committee Recommendations.  
Pursuant to statute, the Advisory Committee has submitted their recommendations  to the 
Commission. The Commission UPHOLDS the findings  of violations  by the Pipeline  Safety 
Division and APPROVES the recommendations  of the Advisory  Committee as listed on the 
attached pages. The Assistant General Counsel to the Division is directed to prepare and send 
notice to the parties advising them of the determination. 
Any approved civil penalties are due within 90 days of the date of this Order unless 
payment arrangements are made with the Secretary of the Commission.   
Any approved trainings must be completed no later than 180 days from the date of this 
Order or the alternative civil penalty noted in the attached recommendation is due.   
IT IS SO ORDERED. 
HUSTON, KREVDA, OBER, AND ZIEGNER CONCUR; FREEMAN ABSENT

PROVED:

14	ORDER OF THE COMMISSION 
15	Ind. Code  ch. 8-1-26  provides the procedure for the Indiana  Utility Regulatory 
16	Commission’s Pipeline Safety Division (“Division”) to find violations  of said  chapter. Upon 
17	review of those findings,  the Indiana Underground Plant Protection Advisory Committee 
18	(“Advisory Committee”) reviews those recommendations and recommends civil penalties in the 
19	Case.   
20	The Cases received pursuant to Ind. Code ch. 8-1-26 and ripe for Commission action are 
21	attached hereto and collectively referred to as the Advisory Committee Recommendations.  
22	Pursuant to statute, the Advisory Committee has submitted their recommendations  to the 
23	Commission. The Commission UPHOLDS the findings  of violations  by the Pipeline  Safety 
24	Division and APPROVES the recommendations  of the Advisory  Committee as listed on the 
25	attached pages. The Assistant General Counsel to the Division is directed  to prepare and send 
26	notice to the parties advising them of the determination. 
27	Any approve d civil penalties are due withi n 90 days of the date of this Order unless 
28	payment arrangements are made with the Secretary of the Commission.   
29	Any approved trainings must be comple ted no later than 180 days from the date of this 
30	Order or the alternative civil penalty noted in the attached recommendation is due.   
31	IT IS SO ORDERED.

PROVED: 
ORDER OF THE COMMISSION 
Ind. Code  ch. 8-1-26  provides the procedure for the Indiana  Utility Regulatory 
Commission’s Pipeline Safety Division (“Division”) to find violations  of said  chapter. Upon 
review of those findings,  the Indiana Underground Plant Protection Advisory Committee 
(“Advisory Committee”) reviews those recommendations and recommends civil penalties in the 
Case.   
The Cases received pursuant to Ind. Code ch. 8-1-26 and ripe for Commission action are 
attached hereto and collectively referred to as the Advisory Committee Recommendations.  
Pursuant to statute, the Advisory Committee has submitted their recommendations  to the 
Commission. The Commission UPHOLDS the findings  of violations  by the Pipeline  Safety 
Division and APPROVES the recommendations  of the Advisory  Committee as listed on the 
attached pages. The Assistant General Counsel to the Division is directed  to prepare and send 
notice to the parties advising them of the determination. 
Any approve d civil penalties are due withi n 90 days of the date of this Order unless 
payment arrangements are made with the Secretary of the Commission.   
Any approved trainings must be comple ted no later than 180 days from the date of this 
Order or the alternative civil penalty noted in the attached recommendation is due.   
IT IS SO ORDERED. 
HUSTON, FREEMAN, OBER, AND ZIEGNER CONCUR; KREVDA ABSENT 
APPROVED: 
I hereby certify that the above is a true 
and correct copy of the Order as approved. 
Dana Kosco
Secretary of the Commission

ORDER OF THE COMMISSION 
Ind. Code  ch. 8-1-26  provides the  procedure for the Indiana  Utility Regulatory 
Commission’s Pipeline Safety Division (“Division”) to find violations  of said  chapter. Upon 
review of  those findings,  the Indiana Underground Plant  Protection  Advisor y Committee 
(“Advisor
y Committee”) reviews those recommendations and recommends civil penalties in the 
Case.   
The Cases received pursuant to Ind. Code ch. 8-1-26 and ripe for Commission action are 
attached hereto and collectively referred to as the Advisory Committee Recommendations.  
Pursuant to statute, the Advisory Committee has submitted their recommendations  to the 
Comm
ission. The Commission  UPHOLDS  the findings  of violations  by  the Pipeline  Safety 
Division and  APPROVES  the recommendations  of the Advisory  Committee  a s listed on the 
att
ached pages. The Assistant General Counsel to the Division is directed  to prepare and send 
notice to the parties advising them of the determination. 
Any approve d civil penalties are due withi n 90 days of the date of thi s Order unless 
pay
ment arrangements are made with the Secretary of the Commission.   
Any approved trainings must be comple ted no late r than 180 day s from the date of this 
Orde
r or the alternative civil penalty noted in the attached recommendation is due.   
IT IS SO ORDERED.

14	ORDER OF THE COMMISSION 
15	Ind. Code ch. 8-1-26 provides the procedure for the Indiana  Utility Regulatory 
16	Commission’s Pipeline Safety  Division (“Division”) to find violations  of said  chapter. Upon 
17	review of those findings,  the Indiana Underground Plant Protection Advisory Committee 
18	(“Advisory Committee”) reviews those recommendations and recommends civil penalties in the 
19	Case.   
20	The Cases received pursuant to Ind. Code ch. 8-1-26 and ripe for Commission action are 
21	attached hereto and collectively referred to as the Advisory Committee Recommendations.  
22	Pursuant to statute, the Advisory Committee has submitted their recommendations  to the 
23	Commission. The Commission UPHOLDS the findings  of violations  by the Pipeline Safety 
24	Division and APPROVES the recommendations  of the Advisory  Committee as listed on the 
25	attached pages. The Assistant General Counsel to the Division is directed to prepare and send 
26	notice to the parties advising them of the determination. 
27	Any approved civil penalties are due within 90 days of the date of this Order unless 
28	payment arrangements are made with the Secretary of the Commission.   
29	Any approved trainings must be completed no later than 180 days from the date of this 
30	Order or the alternative civil penalty noted in the attached recommendation is due.   
31	IT IS SO ORDERED.

PROVED: 
ORDER OF THE COMMISSION 
Ind. Code ch. 8-1-26 provides the procedure for the Indiana  Utility Regulatory 
Commission’s Pipeline Safety  Division (“Division”) to find violations  of said  chapter. Upon 
review of those findings,  the Indiana Underground Plant Protection Advisory Committee 
(“Advisory Committee”) reviews those recommendations and recommends civil penalties in the 
Case.   
The Cases received pursuant to Ind. Code ch. 8-1-26 and ripe for Commission action are 
attached hereto and collectively referred to as the Advisory Committee Recommendations.  
Pursuant to statute, the Advisory Committee has submitted their recommendations  to the 
Commission. The Commission UPHOLDS the findings  of violations  by the Pipeline Safety 
Division and APPROVES the recommendations  of the Advisory  Committee as listed on the 
attached pages. The Assistant General Counsel to the Division is directed to prepare and send 
notice to the parties advising them of the determination. 
Any approved civil penalties are due within 90 days of the date of this Order unless 
payment arrangements are made with the Secretary of the Commission.   
Any approved trainings must be completed no later than 180 days from the date of this 
Order or the alternative civil penalty noted in the attached recommendation is due.   
IT IS SO ORDERED. 
HUSTON, FREEMAN, KREVDA, OBER, AND ZIEGNER CONCUR: 
APPROVED: 
I hereby certify that the above is a true 
and correct copy of the Order as approved. 
Dana Kosco
Secretary of the Commission

ORDER OF THE COMMISSION 
Ind. Code  ch. 8-1-26  provides the  procedure for  the Indiana  Utility  Regulatory 
Commission’s Pipeline Safety Division (“Division”) to find violations  of said  chapter. Upon 
review of  those findings, the Indiana  Underground Plant  Protection Advisory Committee 
(“
Advisory Committee”) reviews those recommendations and recommends civil penalties in the 
Case.   
The Cases received pursuant to Ind. Code ch. 8-1-26 and ripe for Commiss ion action are 
attached hereto and collectively referred to as the Advisory Committee Recommendations.  
Pursuant to statute, the Advisory Committee has submitted their recommendations  to the 
Commission. The Commission  UPHOLDS the  findings of violations  by the Pipeline  Safety 
Division and APPROVES  the recommendations  of the Advisory Committee  as  listed on the 
attached pages. The Assistant General Counsel to  the Division  is directed  to prepare  and send 
notice to the parties advising them of the determination.

payment arrangements are made with the Secretary of the Commission.   
Any approved trainings must be comple ted no late r than 180 da ys from the da te of this 
Order or the alternative civil penalty noted in the attached recommendation is due.   
IT IS SO ORDERED.

18	ORDER OF THE COMMISSION 
19	Ind. Code ch. 8-1-26 provides the procedure for the Indiana Utility Regulatory 
20	Commission's Pipeline Safety Division ("Division") to find violations of said chapter. Upon 
21	review of those findings, the Indiana Underground Plant Protection Advisory Committee 
22	("Advisory Committee") reviews those recommendations and recommends civil penalties in the 
23	Case. 
24	The Cases received pursuant to Ind. Code ch. 8-1-26 and ripe for Commission action are 
25	attached hereto and collectively referred to as the Advisory Committee Recommendations. 
26	Pursuant to statute, the Advisory Committee has submitted their recommendations to the 
27	Commission. The Commission UPHOLDS the findings of violations by the Pipeline Safety 
28	Division and APPROVES the recommendations of the Advisory Committee as listed on the 
29	attached pages. The Assistant General Counsel to the Division is directed to prepare and send 
30	notice to the parties advising them of the determination. 
31	Any approved civil penalties are due within 90 days of the date of this Order unless 
32	payment arrangements are made with the Secretary of the Commission. 
33	Any approved trainings must be completed no later than 180 days from the date of this 
34	Order or the alternative civil penalty noted in the attached recommendation is due. 
35	IT IS SO ORDERED.

APPROVED: 
ORDER OF THE COMMISSION 
Ind. Code ch. 8-1-26 provides the procedure for the Indiana Utility Regulatory 
Commission's Pipeline Safety Division ("Division") to find violations of said chapter. Upon 
review of those findings, the Indiana Underground Plant Protection Advisory Committee 
("Advisory Committee") reviews those recommendations and recommends civil penalties in the 
Case. 
The Cases received pursuant to Ind. Code ch. 8-1-26 and ripe for Commission action are 
attached hereto and collectively referred to as the Advisory Committee Recommendations. 
Pursuant to statute, the Advisory Committee has submitted their recommendations to the 
Commission. The Commission UPHOLDS the findings of violations by the Pipeline Safety 
Division and APPROVES the recommendations of the Advisory Committee as listed on the 
attached pages. The Assistant General Counsel to the Division is directed to prepare and send 
notice to the parties advising them of the determination. 
Any approved civil penalties are due within 90 days of the date of this Order unless 
payment arrangements are made with the Secretary of the Commission. 
Any approved trainings must be completed no later than 180 days from the date of this 
Order or the alternative civil penalty noted in the attached recommendation is due. 
IT IS SO ORDERED. 
HUSTON, FREEMAN, KREVDA, OBER, AND ZIEGNER CONCUR: 
APPROVED: 
I hereby certify that the above is a true 
and correct copy of the Order as approved. 
Dana Kosco

PROVED: 
ORDER OF THE COMMISSION 
Ind. Code  ch. 8-1-26  provides  the  procedure for  the Indiana  Utility  Regulatory 
Commission’s Pipeline Safety Division (“Division”) to find violations  of said  chapter. Upon 
review of  those findings,  the Indiana  Underground  Plant  Protection Advisory  Committee 
(“Advisory Committee”) reviews those recommendations and recommends civil penalties in the 
Case.   
The Cases received pursuant to Ind. Code ch. 8-1- 26 and ripe for Commiss ion action are 
attached hereto and collectively referred to as the Advisory Committee Recommendations.  
Pursuant to statute, the Advisory Committee has submitted their recommendations  to the 
Commission. The Commission  UPHOLDS the findings  of violations  by  the Pipeline  Safety 
Division and APPROVES  the recommendations  of the Advisory  Committee  as  listed on the 
attached pages. The Assistant General Counsel to  the Division  is directed  to prepare  and send 
notice to the parties advising them of the determination. 
Any approve d civil penalt ies are due withi n 90 days of the date of this Order unless 
payment arrangements are made with the Secretary of the Commission.   
Any approved trainings must be comple ted no late r than 180 day s from the date of this 
Order or the alternative civil penalty noted in the attached recommendation is due.   
IT IS SO ORDERED. 
HUSTON, FREEMAN, KREVDA, OBER, AND ZIEGNER CONCUR: 
APPROVED: 
I hereby certify that the above is a true 
and correct copy of the Order as approved. 
Dana Kosco
Secretary of the Commission

PROVED: 
ORDER OF THE COMMISSION 
Ind. Code  ch. 8-1-26  provides  the  procedure for  the Indiana  Utility  Regulatory 
Commission’s Pipeline Safety Division (“Division”) to find violations  of said  chapter. Upon 
review of  those findings,  the Indiana  Underground  Plant  Protection Advisory  Committee 
(“Advisory Committee”) reviews those recommendations and recommends civil penalties in the 
Case.   
The Cases received pursuant to Ind. Code ch. 8-1- 26 and ripe for Commiss ion action are 
attached hereto and collectively referred to as the Advisory Committee Recommendations.  
Pursuant to statute, the Advisory Committee has submitted their recommendations  to the 
Commission. The Commission  UPHOLDS the findings  of violations  by  the Pipeline  Safety 
Division and APPROVES  the recommendations  of the Advisory  Committee  as  listed on the 
attached pages. The Assistant General Counsel to  the Division  is directed  to prepare  and send 
notice to the parties advising them of the determination. 
Any approve d civil penalt ies are due withi n 90 days of the date of this Order unless 
payment arrangements are made with the Secretary of the Commission.   
Any approved trainings must be comple ted no late r than 180 day s from the date of this 
Order or the alternative civil penalty noted in the attached recommendation is due.   
IT IS SO ORDERED. 
HUSTON, FREEMAN, KREVDA, OBER, AND ZIEGNER CONCUR: 
APPROVED: 
I hereby certify that the above is a true 
and correct copy of the Order as approved. 
Dana Kosco
Secretary of the Commission

OVED: 
ORDER OF THE COMMISSION 
Ind. Code ch. 8-1-26 provides  the procedure  for  the Indiana  Utility  Regulatory 
Commission’s Pipeline Safety Division (“Division”) to find violations  of said  chapter. Upon 
review of those findings,  the Indiana  Underground Plant Protection  Advisory Committee 
(“Advisory Committee”) reviews those recommendations and recommends civil penalties in the 
Case.   
The Cases received pursuant to Ind. Code ch. 8-1-26 and ripe for Commiss ion action are 
attached hereto and collectively referred to as the Advisory Committee Recommendations.  
Pursuant to statute, the Advisory Committee has submitted their recommendations  to the 
Commission. The Commission UPHOLDS  the findings  of violations  by the Pipeline  Safety 
Division and APPROVES the recommendations  of the Advisory  Committee as listed  on  the 
attached pages. The Assistant General Counsel to  the Division  is directed  to prepare  and send 
notice to the parties advising them of the determination. 
Any approved civil penalt ies a re due withi n 90 days of th e dat e of thi s Orde r unless 
payment arrangements are made with the Secretary of the Commission.   
Any approved trainings must be comple ted no later than 180 day s from the da te of this 
Order or the alternative civil penalty noted in the attached recommendation is due.   
IT IS SO ORDERED. 
HUSTON, KREVDA, OBER, AND ZIEGNER CONCUR; FREEMAN ABSENT:
APPROVED: 
I hereby certify that the above is a true 
and correct copy of the Order as approved. 
Dana Kosco
Secretary of the Commission

I could not compute the exact means. My tools (Read, Grep, Glob) do not include Bash or Python, and the 2021 and 2025 orders run to thousands of lines each. I read only part of one 2021 order, so the figure below is a rough estimate, not a result.

**Estimate (low confidence):** about **$2,400 per non-utility case in 2021**. This comes from one order, `ord_PSD_020321.pdf`, which I read in full: 48 non-utility cases, total headline penalty $116,500 (mean ≈ $2,427). The 2021 figure would need all eleven 2021 orders, and I have not computed 2025 at all, so I have no 2025 estimate.

**Headline-penalty rules I applied while reading:**
- "Training or $5,000" counts as $5,000.
- "$3,000+ training, or $5,000" counts as $3,000.
- Warning letters, "Training (completed…)", and ".5000" with no "$" count as $0.

**To finish:** a Python pass over the 2021 and 2025 text files (`data/text/`) would parse each recommendation form, apply the utility-respondent list, and take the first dollar amount. Year assignment is also a question: I used the filename date, but the order's signing date should be confirmed in the text.
